technical.title: BEVCA Proposes Adversarial Camouflage for Multi-View BEV 3D Perception
technical.summary: A novel adversarial camouflage framework called BEVCA targets multi-view Bird's-Eye-View 3D perception models in autonomous driving by integrating a BEV-feature-based adversarial loss with a multi-view neural rendering module.
technical.why: It highlights vulnerabilities and tests the robustness of modern multi-view 3D perception systems against physical camouflage attacks.

technical.title: Tsinghua Open-Sources AKV Cache Engineering Server for LLM Agents
technical.summary: Tsinghua researchers released AKV, an SGLang-based serving system for cache engineering that lets LLM agents drop and reposition KV cache instead of summarizing history, reducing average costs by 27.7% across four agent benchmarks.
technical.why: It lowers the computational and financial overhead of running memory-intensive LLM agents.

technical.title: FocusVLA Introduces Future-Intent Guided Dynamic View Routing for Robots
technical.summary: FocusVLA addresses the limitation where multi-view vision-language-action models over-rely on wrist views by dynamically adjusting global-local view dependencies across manipulation stages to improve robustness.
technical.why: It improves multi-view complementarity exploitation for robotic manipulation policies.

technical.title: Microsoft Open-Sources Agensh Multi-Agent Harness for 1,024 Agents
technical.summary: Microsoft Research open-sourced Agensh, a multi-agent harness with no central orchestrator where self-organizing workers share a Git repo, chat, and findings board to scale up to 1,024 agents.
technical.why: It provides a framework for scaling and coordinating massive decentralized multi-agent systems.

technical.title: PnP* Proposes First Certifiable Global Solver for Perspective-n-Point
technical.summary: Researchers proposed PnP*, the first practical solver guaranteeing efficient computation and globally optimal solutions for the Maximum Likelihood Estimation of the Perspective-n-Point camera pose problem.
technical.why: It establishes a mathematically sound and stable solution for a fundamental computer vision problem.

technical.title: Flora Open Model Suite Scales Industrial Robotics Data Engines
technical.summary: Flora is an industrial-quality robotics data engine used to train GR00T models, providing outcome rewards, process rewards, and timestamped captions to achieve state-of-the-art benchmark scores.
technical.why: It provides a comprehensive data curation and reward labeling framework for training robotics foundation models.

technical.title: RoboJudge Evaluates Multimodal Large Language Models for Embodied Video Generation
technical.summary: Researchers introduced RoboJudge-Bench to systematically evaluate multimodal large language models as judges of embodied video generation across Physical Adherence and Instruction Alignment using 800 human-annotated videos.
technical.why: It provides a rigorous way to measure how well video models generate physically valid and task-compliant actions.

technical.title: KiRoSe Uses Robot Kinematic Data for Efficient Demonstration Segmentation
technical.summary: KiRoSe automates the segmentation of robot demonstration data by utilizing companion streams of robot kinematic data instead of expensive raw multi-camera video streams.
technical.why: It avoids context window exhaustion and high costs when processing multi-camera demonstration datasets.

technical.title: HGWM Achieves Zero-Shot Object Navigation via Hierarchical Graph-Guided Models
technical.summary: HGWM couples an LLM-generated room-anchor prior with persistent spatial-semantic memory, combining coarse visual-semantic scoring and fine symbolic compatibility for zero-shot object navigation.
technical.why: It advances zero-shot navigation capabilities and spatial reasoning for embodied agents.

technical.title: NVIDIA Mission Control 2.5 Brings Autonomous Recovery to Kubernetes
technical.summary: NVIDIA Mission Control 2.5 introduces automated monitoring and recovery features to optimize cluster resiliency during large-scale AI model training on thousands of GPUs.
technical.why: It addresses critical infrastructure uptime requirements for massive GPU cluster training workloads.

business.title: Anthropic officially files for its public debut
business.summary: Anthropic filed for an IPO, revealing soaring revenue, mounting losses, major enterprise adoption, and a unique governance structure aimed at preserving its safety mission.
business.why: Public market financial disclosures from top AI labs provide vital visibility into industry business models.

business.title: Meta announces $95 billion stock offering for AI expansion
business.summary: Meta plans to raise $95 billion to fund AI infrastructure and superintelligence, with chipmakers Nvidia, AMD, and Broadcom eyeing up to $5 billion in shares.
business.why: This massive funding round highlights the astronomical capital expenditures required to scale advanced AI hardware infrastructure.

business.title: SoftBank plans $50 billion tech and AI investment in Malaysia
business.summary: SoftBank Group reportedly plans to invest $50 billion in Malaysia's technology sector, focusing on artificial intelligence and data centers.
business.why: This massive capital injection highlights expanding global infrastructure investments in AI markets.

business.title: SpaceX closes $40 billion debt deal to purchase GPUs
business.summary: Elon Musk announced in an X post that SpaceX has successfully closed $40 billion in debt financing designated specifically for purchasing AI chips.
business.why: Hardware acquisition scale at this level directly impacts high-end GPU market dynamics and compute availability.

business.title: Anthropic files S-1 prospectus to list on Nasdaq
business.summary: Anthropic filed its S-1 prospectus with the SEC to prepare for an IPO on the Nasdaq under the ticker symbol ANT, aiming to beat OpenAI to the public market.
business.why: Tracking major AI lab public offerings gives engineers insight into industry commercialization timelines.

business.title: Apollo economist says AI delivers zero financial payoff to corporations
business.summary: An Apollo economist stated that despite massive investments and widespread hype, artificial intelligence has delivered zero financial payoff to corporate America outside of the tech sector.
business.why: Market sentiment and ROI reality checks heavily influence enterprise software budgets and engineering strategies.

business.title: When Traction Becomes Personal Exposure: What The Joonko Guilty Plea Means For Founders
business.summary: False claims about customers, revenue and AI capabilities can expose founders to personal securities-fraud liability, with D&O insurance offering limited protection against established misconduct. Guest author Kyle Jezio

business.title: California Startups Have Raised More So Far In 2026 Than The Entire US Ever Has In A Single Year
business.summary: California companies have scooped up more than three-fourths of all U.S. startup funding this year. That, per Crunchbase data, is an apparent record share. And keep in mind: This year still has a couple months left.

business.title: Anthropic’s IPO Prospectus Reveals What’s Under the Hood
business.summary: Anthropic on Monday filed documents ahead of a blockbuster IPO that offers insight into the company’s financials, risk factors, and views on the future of AI.

business.title: Meet the AI Agents Trying to Be Real-Life Journalists
business.summary: Jayden, Sam, and Zack are eagerly pitching editors on reported stories and investigative features. The catch? They're all AI agents.

models.title: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 Update Delivers Substantial Performance Gains Across Benchmarks
models.summary: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 is a minor update improving reasoning, coding, agentic tasks, and visual benchmarks while reducing execution time and output length.
models.why: It improves the performance-cost Pareto frontier for agent harnesses.

models.title: MiniMax-M3.1-Flash Launches Native Multimodal Mixture-of-Experts Model
models.summary: MiniMax-M3.1-Flash is a native multimodal MoE model supporting text, image, and video inputs with up to 1M token context, featuring sparse attention, quantization-aware training, and speculative decoding for efficiency.
models.why: It offers high performance on multimodal agentic, coding, and computer use tasks.

models.title: Sage-A1.5 Introduced as 35B Mixture-of-Experts Agentic Model
models.summary: Sage-A1.5 is a 35B MoE agentic model based on Qwen3.6 and Agents-A1, designed to advance long-horizon scientific problem solving through adaptive capability composition and work organization.
models.why: It advances open-source capabilities in long-horizon agentic scientific reasoning.

models.title: Recursive Flint Introduces Mixture-of-Experts Language Model for Coding Agents
models.summary: Flint is a 39.8B parameter mixture-of-experts model designed for coding agents to investigate codebases, fix bugs, implement features, and write tests, utilizing about 2.5B active parameters per token.
models.why: It provides a dedicated MoE option optimized for automated software engineering and code generation.

models.title: Nanbeige4.3-33B Released as Flagship Teacher Model for Lightweight Agents
models.summary: Nanbeige4.3-33B is a 33B parameter flagship teacher model designed to anchor the distillation of advanced agentic capabilities into smaller models, excelling at complex coding and professional cowork tasks.
models.why: It serves as an open high-capacity teacher model for building efficient lightweight agents.

models.title: Spark-X2.6-4B Advances On-Device Agent Capabilities Through Post-Training
models.summary: Spark-X2.6-4B is a compact, general-purpose language model for on-device deployment that retains the exact architecture of Spark-X2.5-4B while achieving capability gains through improved post-training.
models.why: It pushes the frontier of efficient, on-device AI agents.
